# netbox_service_template (Data Source)

A service template: a named protocol and port set that services can be created from (ipam.servicetemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/servicetemplate/):

> Application service templates can be used to instantiate [application services](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/service/) on [devices](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/device/) and [virtual machines](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/virtualization/virtualmachine/).
>
> **Changed in NetBox v4.4:** Previously, application service templates were referred to simply as "service templates". The name has been changed in the UI to better reflect their intended use. There is no change to the name of the model or in any programmatic NetBox APIs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_service_template" "test" {
  name = "test-service_template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol. One of: tcp, udp, sctp.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `ports` (Set of Number) Port numbers.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
